description: CLI argument parsing for both the main sync command and the set-folder-dates companion script. Supports --help/-h flags, positional target-path arguments, --dry-run (set-folder-dates only), and rejects unknown arguments with usage text and exit code 2.
notes: Backfilled by feature-coverage-audit from current implementation evidence on 2026-06-10.
Shared logic extracted to src/lib/cli-utils.ts via folded reorg audit finding (consolidated 2026-06-11).

Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): added --help/-h for both entry points, unknown arguments exit 2 with usage text, positional target-path accepted, --dryrun/-dryrun aliases removed in favor of canonical --dry-run.
spec:
1. Verify --help and -h display usage text and exit with code 0 for both sync and set-folder-dates.
2. Verify an optional positional target-path argument is accepted.
3. Verify unknown flags produce an error message with usage text and exit code 2.
4. Verify --dry-run is accepted by set-folder-dates but rejected by the sync command.
5. Verify repeated positional arguments are rejected.
6. Verify shared CLI utilities (stripQuotes, resolveTargetPath) live in src/lib/cli-utils.ts and are imported by both src/index.ts and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts; each consumer keeps its own specialized parseArgs (sync flags vs --dry-run) but delegates shared logic — do NOT duplicate utility functions between the two entry points.
title: CLI Argument Parsing
